page_data.en:
PASSPORT & REGISTRATION OFFICE,
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 〔此处转录不清〕
SHANGHAI REGISTRY
30th April, 1940.
Date ____

Dear Mr. Yorke,

May I worry you again about "missing" persons.
I enclose a letter from Mrs. N.E. Norman
enquiring as to the whereabouts of her son, George Norman.
According to our records George Norman (born 2/4/1906),
occupation, Greyhound trainer, was last registered in this
Consulate-General on the 14th January, 1931. When his address
was 20 Thorburn Road, Shanghai.

Thank you again for your assistance.

Yours sincerely,

〔签名〕

R.W. Yorke, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（右侧盖章内容：MUNICIPAL POLICE / SHANGHAI REGISTRY / No. S.B. D. / 4003）

护照与登记处，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
邮政信箱〔此处转录不清〕
上海登记处
1940年4月30日。
日期 ____

约克先生台鉴：

关于“失踪”人员一事，恕我再次打扰。
现随函附上 N.E. 诺曼夫人的一封信，询问其子乔治·诺曼的下落。
根据我方记录，乔治·诺曼（生于1906年4月2日），职业为赛狗驯养师，最后一次在本总领事馆登记是在1931年1月14日。当时他的住址是上海索伯恩路20号。

再次感谢您的协助。

此致
敬礼

〔签名〕

R.W. 约克 先生，
副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（右侧盖章内容：工部局警务处 / 上海登记处 / 编号 S.B. D. / 4003）

page_data.en:
COPY

55 Harlescott Road,
Nunhead, S.E. 15,
London,
England.

13/3/1940.

Dear Sir,

My son, George Joseph Norman (now aged 34)
left England 12 years ago last November for Shanghai
as a Greyhound Dog Trainer to the British Association
Greyhound Track at Shanghai. I heard from him occasionally
for about 4 years then I understood the Track closed and
he went training at Canidrome and sent his sister a sheet
from the Canidrome Weekly dated 9.2.35 showing him as
heading the list of trainers at Canidrome for the month
of January.

Since then we have not had any news at all,
although I have made several inquires, the last address
I had of his was
262 Rue Pere Robert,
Shanghai.

and I sent him some photos to this address but they were
returned not known.

I have family news I wish to convoy to him and
wondered if you could trace him or advise me to whom I
might write.

Thanking you in anticipation for any help that you
can give me.

I remain

Respectfully

(SIGNED) Mrs. M.E. Norman.
page_data.zh:
副本

英格兰伦敦，
南黑德区，东南15区，
哈勒斯考特路55号。

1940年3月13日。

敬启者：

吾儿乔治·约瑟夫·诺曼（现年34岁）于12年前的去年11月离开英国前往上海，担任上海英国协会赛狗场的赛狗驯养师。在大约4年的时间里，我偶尔收到他的来信，随后得知该赛狗场关闭，他便去逸园跑狗场（Canidrome）从事驯养工作，并寄给他妹妹一张日期为1935年2月9日的《逸园周刊》，显示他在一月份位列逸园驯养师名单之首。

自那以后，我们便杳无音信，尽管我曾多次查询。我所掌握的他的最后一个地址是：
上海雷米路262号。

我曾按此地址给他寄去一些照片，但因“查无此人”被退回。

我有家讯欲转达给他，不知阁下能否协助查找其下落，或告知我该致信何人。

预先感谢阁下所能提供的任何帮助。

此致
敬礼

（签名）M.E. 诺曼夫人。

〔此处转录不清〕
May 1 40.

Dear Mr. Cox,

In reply to your letter dated
April 30 regarding the whereabouts of
Mr. George Joseph Norman, I have to inform
you that Mr. Norman is still employed at the
Canidrome and letters can be addressed to his
place of employment or to his private residence,
Apartment 3, No. 91 Route Remi.

Yours sincerely,
Rudy

A. T. Cox, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

〔此处转录不清〕

1940年5月1日。

考克斯先生台鉴：

就阁下4月30日来信询问乔治·约瑟夫·诺曼先生下落一事，兹复告如下：诺曼先生目前仍受雇于逸园跑狗场（Canidrome），信件可寄至其工作地点或其私人住所：雷米路91号3室。

此致
敬礼

鲁迪

A. T. 考克斯 先生，
英国驻华总领事馆，
上海。

〔此处转录不清〕
